decls.name: UnboundSidecarSchema
decls.doc: A DAK sidecar the enumeration lists that could not be bound to an artefact.

fields.name: filename
fields.doc: The sidecar file the enumeration named.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: Its title, as the enumeration gives it — usually the only human handle on what was missed.

fields.name: enumeration
fields.doc: Which enumeration listed it.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why no artefact matched: the strategies tried, in order.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The scheme's local id: the tail of its IRI.

fields.name: hasVersion
fields.doc: dcterms:hasVersion.

fields.name: modified
fields.doc: dcterms:modified, a date.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: dcterms:source: what the terms were drawn from.

fields.name: license
fields.doc: The licence the terms are published under: an SPDX id or a URL.

fields.name: members
fields.doc: External concept IRIs this glossary lists without copying: a `skos:Collection`.

decls.name: Iri
decls.doc: An absolute IRI: an external concept, a source, a scheme.

fields.name: notation
fields.doc: The code. SKOS's own word for it.

fields.name: broader
fields.doc: Local term ids or absolute IRIs.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: Where the term came from: a repository path (with #anchor) or an IRI.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Required for `could-not-extract`: a person must be able to act on it.

decls.name: LibraryRef
decls.doc: A citation into L1 content. `instance` absent means *this* instance.

fields.name: instance
fields.doc: The DECLARED NAME of the instance holding the corpus — not a path.

decls.name: LibraryRefFailure
decls.doc: Why a reference did not resolve. Distinct cases, deliberately — see the module doc.

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.doc: When the digest was last RE-COMPUTED against the bytes, not when it was recorded. An unverified digest ages.

decls.doc: Whether the local copy may be trusted right now.

fields.doc: Who or what decided, and when. A verdict with no date cannot be re-checked.

decls.name: GatesSchema
decls.doc: The five, all required. A materialisation that skipped one would be a materialisation whose worst risk is the one nobody wrote down.

decls.name: MaterializationSchema
decls.doc: What a node says about itself.

fields.name: provenance
fields.doc: WHERE THIS CAME FROM — see {@link ProvenanceSchema}.

fields.name: localPath
fields.doc: Where the bytes landed, instance-relative. Present iff `materialized`.

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: Bytes held locally. Absent means not measured, which is not zero.

fields.doc: Bytes the WHOLE remote collection holds, where it is known. This is what

fields.name: purpose
fields.doc: Why the bytes were taken. Required on anything materialized — the gates mean different things under each.

fields.name: fixity
fields.doc: Required when `purpose` is `archival` or `both`.

fields.name: inputs
fields.doc: Required when `purpose` is `compiled`, and only allowed then. See {@link CompiledInputsSchema}.

fields.name: materializedAt
fields.doc: When the local copy was taken, and against what upstream version.

fields.name: expiresAt
fields.doc: When this copy expires. Absent on a `working` copy is a `retention`

fields.name: note
fields.doc: Why the record cannot say more than it does.

decls.name: ProvenanceSchema
decls.doc: WHERE THIS CAME FROM — a pointer pair, not a flag.

fields.name: upstream
fields.doc: The remote thing. A URI, always — never a path, never a bare name. Absent means NOT RECORDED, which is not "there is none".

fields.name: local
fields.doc: The original **in this repository** this was taken from.

decls.name: SignatureSchema
decls.doc: A digital signature over the materialized bytes.

fields.name: format
fields.doc: How to interpret `value` — a media type or a named scheme.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: The signature itself, or a URI that resolves to it.

fields.name: signer
fields.doc: Who signed, as a key identifier.

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.doc: When it was last CHECKED against the signer's key — never when it was recorded. Same discipline as {@link FixitySchema.verifiedAt}.

decls.name: AnchorChange
decls.doc: The two ChangeSet entries that move an anchor. Structural, so no import cycle.

decls.name: BlockAnchor
decls.doc: One block as the head has it: its content hash and the labels it used to have.

fields.name: section
fields.doc: The section listing the block (the ChangeSet's form). The heat map's row for its comments (bean `qbfi`).

fields.name: unchanged
fields.doc: Already ingested. Same id, so nothing new.

fields.name: malformed
fields.type: Array<{ commentId: number; url: string; error: string }>
fields.doc: Tagged but malformed: said, not dropped, so the reviewer can fix it.

fields.name: untagged
fields.doc: No tag: ordinary conversation. Counted so "nothing ingested" is explained.

decls.name: PrComment
decls.doc: A PR conversation comment, in the fields GitHub's API returns.

decls.name: ProcessTask
decls.doc: A task in a BPMN process: the only thing allowed to move a comment.

fields.name: process
fields.doc: The `<bpmn:process id>`.

fields.name: task
fields.doc: The task's id in that process.
